page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Running head at the top centre. Page number at the top right. One marginal reference in the right margin, beside the line "quàm quod olim dicebat Christus?". Edge marks at the left edge and a handwritten or stamped "142" at the top right are not printed text.

main_text.p: vocanda misericorditer, cur non (inquam) hos omnes in eadē charitatis radice, & succo veritatis, eadem cognitionis luce, eademque Christianitatis forma cognoscamus? Hæc enim illa ratio est, quæ recreauit summaque lætitia Davidem affecit, & omnes bonos exemplo eius affectura est: hæc illa forma cuius conscientia Apostolus non dubitabat dicere, Sive infanimus, infanimus Deo; sive sana mente sumus, vobis mente sana sumus: adeò poslidebat vera illa formā hominis Christiani Apostolum Christi, ut non ad se respiceret, sed ad Christum caput nostrum, & in Christo omnia membra corporis illius in veritate, scientiâ, & charitate Christiana amplexaretur studio & amore infuperabili. Horum exemplis si nos religiosè studebimus conformare, & mysterium pietatis in bona conscientia & fide αὐτοκέιτῳ[?] & charitate retinebimus; non dubium est quin eiusdem lætitiæ cùm in hoc, tum in futuro seculo confortes futuri simus per Dei misericordiam. Sed, cheu, si ad hæc tempora oculos & cogitationes nostras convertimus, quid aliud dicturi sumus, quàm quod olim dicebat Christus? Væ mundoMat.18. propter scandala: væ homini per quem evenient scandala. Prospiciat gratiosè pater ille misericordiarum, & mundum ruentem gratia salutari retrahat. Omninò, ut res sunt, forma illa Christianitatis deperit, quâ Deus scripturis expres-sit, quam sancti vitâ adumbrárunt, quam deni-que Christi-

page.notes: Printed "142" at top right is handwriting or a stamp, not printed text, so it is left out. Edge marks at the left margin (e.g. ")" and "." before "nostrum") are show-through or edge artefacts and are left out. The Greek word "αὐτοκέιτῳ" is doubtful and is marked [?]. "poslidebat" is copied as the scan shows it and may be a printer's ligature for "possidebat". Long s is normalised to s throughout; the printed f-forms of long s (e.g. "misericorditer") are read as s. The reference "Mat.18." is set as printed. The text ends on a hyphenated line, "que Chri-", so no catchword is recorded.
